trace_reply.stopped_length: The reply was cut off before the end, so it wasn't used. Try again, or ask for less at once.
trace_reply.stopped_thinking: The model gave its reasoning but no answer. Try again, or turn its reasoning down.
trace_reply.stopped_empty: The model sent back an empty answer. Anything Trace already did this turn is kept, so check before asking again.
trace_reply.out_of_rounds: That took more steps than one answer allows, and nothing came back. Ask for less at once, such as one category or a narrower search.
trace_reply.out_of_rounds_import: That took more steps than one request allows. Try a smaller part at a time.
trace_reply.stuck_on_tool: Trace kept asking for the same information and got no answer, so it stopped. Try asking another way.

trace_ai_ct.unreachable: Couldn't get an answer from {host}. Check the Base URL in Settings > AI Assistant. If it's right, that server has to allow requests from {origin} on every answer, errors included (with nginx, add_header … always), or Trace can be set up on the CookTrace server instead.
trace_ai_ct.unreachable_insecure: This page is on HTTPS, so the browser won't call {host} over plain HTTP. Give your provider an https:// address, or set Trace up on the CookTrace server instead.
trace_ai_ct.unreachable_official: {host} didn't answer. Check this device's connection.

toast.voice_unsupported: This browser doesn't support voice input.
toast.configure_ai: Set up Trace in Settings > Trace to use hold-to-talk.
toast.enable_smart_log: Turn on Smart Log in Settings > Trace to use hold-to-talk.
toast.voice_needs_https: Voice input needs HTTPS. Browsers block the microphone over plain HTTP, so set up TLS or use your public address.
toast.trace_disabled: Trace is turned off. Turn it on in Settings > Trace.
toast.voice_unsupported_full: This browser doesn't support voice input. Try Chrome, or Safari on an iPhone.
toast.voice_needs_https_smart: Smart Log needs HTTPS. Browsers block the microphone over plain HTTP, so set up TLS or use your public address.

trace_ai_ct.tools_unsupported: This model can't use tools: it can answer, but it can't look up or change your recipes and pantry. Pick a model with tool support in Settings.
trace_ai_ct.tools_unsupported_routed: The model that answered can't use tools, so nothing was looked up or changed.
trace_ai_ct.tools_unsupported_import: This model can't use tools, so it can't import recipes. Pick a model with tool support in Settings.
